name: Tran's Conjecture 8.6 on regular Morley tetrahedra (refuted)
target: arXiv:2609.06553 Conjecture 8.6: a regular Morley tetrahedron from p-secting planes forces a pair of opposite edges with four equal cross edges
result: False: every isosceles tetrahedron with three different edge lengths is a counterexample (Theorem 1.3, Corollary 1.4).
